description:
In the rotten neighborhood of Changseong, a girl named Hui-Eon lived crushed under debt. When she was on the verge of being dragged into the red-light district, it was the gangster Mugeul, appearing like the wind, who saved her.

 *“I'm good at studying. I can pay off the debt without having to work down there.” 

“This little thing's surprisingly impressive. Start working here tomorrow.”*

Spending time by Mugil's side, Hui-Eon gradually succumbs to his warmth. But the moment he realizes her feelings, Mugil turns cold, unlike before...

 *“Just call me ‘Uncle’. I'm not your boss when you're sucking dick.”*

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
